formulas.ascii: For each nonzero hull edge e, use its unit direction u and left normal n. Candidate area A[e]=(max dot(h,u)-min dot(h,u))*(max dot(h,n)-min dot(h,n)). Start B at the first candidate; replace it only when A[e] < (1-1e-6)*B. rectangleSizes.area is the last B. Hull points are anchor-relative; one-point/collinear rectangles have zero area, empty or overflowing hulls report NaN. This formula describes the rectangle selection; circles use shuffled Welzl with a recomputed covering radius.
